== Summary ==

The matching before crop is [[:File:V21-L-eventuallyyoulllose-2026-03-07-change-crop-before.png]]. Compared with the image of [[Eventually You'll Lose (V)]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/04fafe9a4fc2c8a87e045ba98e3a4c685106d50c/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual21-Light/large/eventuallyyoulllose.gif commit 04fafe9]) and [[Eventually You'll Lose (V)]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e02f932ae2c407c7c4f2e22fe565a8a64afd742b/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual21-Light/large/eventuallyyoulllose.gif commit e02f932]).
